envelope.description: Replace scoped scans with indexed reads

body.title: Replace scoped scans with indexed reads
body.summary: Use exact-key candidates for file/repo reads, grouped files, deletion collectors and reindex snapshots. Resolve authoritative rows in consistent snapshots; preserve exact path equality and u64 ordering and report dangling-index corruption. Explicitly verify snapshot consistency, forced digest collisions and row-access bounds.
acceptanceChecks: Scoped operations work when entity.getRange throws and do not read unrelated rows.
Unicode/long paths and forced digest collision preserve exact matching; dangling references error.

tests.name: Scoped queries, collectors and reindex snapshots avoid full scans and unrelated row reads
Exact contents/u64 order, snapshot consistency and forced digest collision filtering
